book.name: Akatecholonike
book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Akatecholonike

content: Kujhomolela tukahotwii jhe kuhimbilila. Yene tukahighilike kutama kanjika jhito ku Atene,
na kuntuma kwino nnongo gwito Timocheyo, jwakibha nhenga lihengo nnyito mulihengo lya Chapanga mukutangacha Malobhe gha Mbone gha Kilichitu. Tukantumite ankangamaliche na kunneke mwojho,
kupala kihobholelo cha mundo jhojhoha pakate jhino kikoto kutundangalila kwa nhwalo gwa malagho gheniya. Mangota umanye kubhehe tupalwa kung'ahika.
Putukibha pamonga na mangota, tukannobholile kubhehe naung'ahichwa, na anda chiumanye, yenio ndi chiipitile.

Ghono ndi nhwalo gwa kuntuma Timocheyo kwino. Nikahotwii jhe kuhimbilila kabhele, nintumite kupala manye malobhe gha kihobholelo chino. Nyogwipa Jwanganandela kunyigha na lihengo lituhengita pakate jhino lihobhole jhajhe!

Nambo ngohe Timocheyo abhujhite kuhumii kwino, jwenio atulobholile malobhe gha kuhanganila gha kihobholelo chino na upalo gwino. Atulobholile kubhehe mutukomboka machiko ghoha, na mipala kukongana na twenga na twenga hele tubhii nakilolo chukukongana na mangota.
Bhahe, malobhe gha kihobholelo chino ghatukangamaliche mwojho mu malagho na mang'ahiko ghito ghoha,
nhwalo ngohe tutama chakaka, anda mangota nnyema nganganga mu kulombana na Bhambo.
Ngohe tuhoto kunnomba Chapanga gwito kwa nhwalo gwino. Tunnomba kwa luhanganilo lutubhinako palonge jhake kwa nhwalo gwino mangota.
Tujhendelela kunnyopa Chapanga kilo na muhe kwa mwojho gwito ghoha tupala atupekeye pwache jha kukongana kabhele na tunnyyonjekeye chochoha chikipongwiye mu kihobholelo chino.
Tunnyopa Chapanga, Tate gwito, na Bhambo gwito Yecho, atulengenikii ndela jha kukongana na mangota.
Bhambo anyonjekeye mapalano gha bhene kwa bhene na kwapala bhando bhoha, ngita twenga chitumpala mangota.
Yene naikangamalicha miojho jhino, mangota namma manga malemo namma manyahinyahi palonge jha Chapanga na Tate gwito, peniya Bhambo gwito Yecho papakuhika pamonga na bhando bhake bhoha.
